meta.datasetTh: นิคม สวน และเขตอุตสาหกรรม
meta.sheetTitle: CityMETER Industrial Estates — นิคม สวน และเขตอุตสาหกรรม 106 รายการ — Research Master 2026-10-25

r8.note: R8 review tabs are supplemental records joined by estate_id: logos (LOGO_LIBRARY_R8), English names (10_FIELD_EVIDENCE_R8, source_supported), outline QA (29_BOUNDARY_QA_R8: more than 15 % from the source area; whole coverage unconfirmed for every outline) and owner customer lists (DEMO_DIRECTORY_SOURCES_R8, linked, counts never shown). No new geometry.

r9.note: R9 widens what the demo may draw (owner-confirmed for the demo): 64 estates from 66 OpenStreetMap source parts (each part drawn on its own, never merged, cut or stretched), 3 context areas apart from the estate outlines, 39 with no outline that can be shown. display_label_th and uncertainty_note of 30_DEMO_COVERAGE_R9 stay beside the shape. Whole extent, current boundary, legal boundary and factory membership are verified for none.

around.source: CityMETER Factory rows with a published point (data/factories.json of this repository)
around.rule: straight-line distance from the point to the OpenStreetMap outline ≤ 3 km (0 inside it); a context set, never membership
around.workers: CityMETER Factory worker figures: DIW คนงานรวม first; MOI TOTAL_WORKER only where DIW has none (Factory 0.9.0) — `moi`/`moiWorkers` count the MOI figures of a set; `unstated` = [workers, registrations] without a DIW industry group, kept apart from the ranked families

workerSources.what: คนงานรวม of the DIW class 2/3 exports
TOTAL_WORKER of ข้อมูลโรงงานอุตสาหกรรม (ops_13_01), only where DIW has no figure
workerSources.dateIs: source row update date (LAST_UPDATE), not when the workers were counted

demoPackage.note: Prepared bundle named in DEMO_README; read through the sheet tabs it was built from (the archive itself is larger than the Drive connector returns)

excludedFields: directory names written as a natural person's (shown as ผู้ประกอบการบุคคลธรรมดา, never sent to Google)
source_record_id and IEAT directory detail URLs per company
review notes, hold reasons by review id, candidate geometry ids other than the demo selection
geometry area (QA only in the master, not an official area)
parcel or contact data of any source
